experiment: E34 frozen-return diagnosis of completed E33
selection: All3 seeds,3 training arms,12 held-out source streams,5 treatments. No fitting or selection of checkpoints. Source streams are reused post hoc diagnostic data, not fresh generalization evidence.
current: Restore fast weights from the end of the last interfering context before A returns. Clear KV exactly as in E33.
archive: Restore fast weights saved after the first A. Clear KV. This is an oracle snapshot-selection upper bound, not a deployed memory mechanism or a free resource.
reset: Restore trained initialization, clear KV, never adapt on the return.
frozen: Continue causal local-context processing, but disable all gradient-based weight updates on the return. Targets only score predictions.
metrics: Report first chunk before any update, first full cycle and complete-return NLL/accuracy. Condition forgetting interpretation on source first-A acquisition. No new competence threshold or aggregate success claim.
invariants: Current-adaptive reexecutes exact E33 return logits/losses/final state. Current-frozen first chunk matches it exactly; archive frozen/adaptive first chunks match. Frozen fast weights and all trained initialization weights remain exact. Source files/checkpoints never mutate.
cost: Charge all forward work, updates, wall time and archive tensor bytes. Archived state restoration is external scaffolding; source training remains charged. Attention entries are not FLOPs; tensor bytes are not total process RAM.
